***
## Species distribution

The map below displays the locations of hydra collected throughout the world.  These **hydras were identified by sequencing** the Internal Transcribed Spacers (ITS-1 and ITS-2) of ribosomal DNA. This marker is very effective to distinguish between different species because the sequences are quite distinct (Martínez et al, 2010). When possible the identification was corroborated by looking at morphological traits like nematocysts (mainly stenoteles and holotrychous isorhizas), embryothecae, and tentacle emergence in buds (see the [key to identify clades](groups.qmd) for additional details).

Please enlarge map to see all the collection locations (some points are not visible at this scale). There is little we can do about the map projection which distorts the true areas of the world exaggerating lands at higher latitudes. 


```{r}
#| echo: false
# 1. Load libraries and copy data
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(leaflet)

hydra_sw <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dem04747/Data2/main/strains_nov26.csv")

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Filter empty cells for species, lat2, and long2
# Select relevant columns
hydra_redux <- hydra_sw |>
  select(local_name,strain,species,lat2,long2,col_locality,col_name,photo_url)|>
  # filter(col_name != "Richard Campbell") |>
  filter(!is.na(species) & species != "" & str_trim(species) != "") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(lat2) & lat2 != "" & str_trim(lat2) != "",
    !is.na(long2) & long2 != "" & str_trim(long2) != ""
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Ensure your coordinates are numeric
hydra_clean <- hydra_redux |> 
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2))
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

library(RColorBrewer)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Define your specific species and their exact colors
species_colors <- c(
  "canadensis"     = "gold",
  "circumcincta"   = "purple",
  "hymanae"        = "#2bdff6",
  "lirosoma"       = "#f07cb8",
  "oligactis"      = "darkorange",
  "oxycnida"       = "#e7298a",
  "unknown"        = "#4393c3",
  "utahensis"      = "blue",
  "viridissima"    = "#08a90e",
  "vulgaris"       = "#342626"
)

# 2. Create the color factor mapping using the named vector
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = species_colors,
  domain = names(species_colors) # or hydra_clean$species
)

leaflet(hydra_clean) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long2, lat = ~lat2,
    color = ~pal(species),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
  "<b>Species:</b> H. ", species, "<br>",
  "<b>Strain:</b> ", strain, "<br>",
  "<b>Locality:</b> ", col_locality, "<br>",
  "<b>Collector:</b> ", col_name, "<br>",
  "<b>Google Maps:</b> <a href='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=", lat2, ",", long2, "' target='_blank'>Open in Google Maps</a><br>",
  "<a href='", photo_url, "' target='_blank'>",
  "<img src='", photo_url, "' style='width:100%; max-width:500px; height:auto; border-radius:4px; margin-top:5px;'></a>")
) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright", 
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~species, 
    title = "Species", 
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var d = document.querySelectorAll('.info.legend i');
      for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
        d[i].style.borderRadius = '50%';
        d[i].style.width = '12px';
        d[i].style.height = '12px';
        d[i].style.marginTop = '3px';
      }
    }
  ")
```

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Define your specific species and their exact colors
species_colors <- c(
  "canadensis"     = "gold",
  "circumcincta"   = "purple",
  "hymanae"        = "#2bdff6",
  "lirosoma"       = "#f07cb8",
  "oligactis"      = "darkorange",
  "oxycnida"       = "#e7298a",
  "unknown"        = "#4393c3",
  "utahensis"      = "blue",
  "viridissima"    = "#08a90e",
  "vulgaris"       = "#342626"
)

# 2. Create the color factor mapping using the named vector
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = species_colors,
  domain = names(species_colors) # or hydra_clean$species
)
# 3. Create map
leaflet(hydra_clean) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long2, lat = ~lat2,
    color = ~pal(species),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Species:</b> H. ", species, "<br>",
      "<b>Strain:</b> ", strain, "<br>",
      "<b>Locality:</b> ", col_locality, "<br>",
      "<b>Collector:</b> ", col_name, "<br>",
      "<b>Google Maps:</b> <a href='[https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=)", lat2, ",", long2, "' target='_blank'>Open in Google Maps</a><br>",
      
      # Thumbnail with an onclick event to open an on-page overlay
      "<img src='", photo_url, "' style='width:100%; max-width:250px; height:auto; border-radius:4px; margin-top:5px; cursor:pointer;' onclick='document.getElementById(\"modal_", strain, "\").style.display=\"flex\"'>",
      
      # Hidden overlay container on the same page
      "<div id='modal_", strain, "' style='display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8); z-index:9999; justify-content:center; align-items:center;' onclick='this.style.display=\"none\"'>",
      "<img src='", photo_url, "' style='max-width:90%; max-height:90%; border-radius:8px; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);'>",
      "</div>"
    ) # Closes paste0()
  ) %>% # Closes addCircleMarkers()
  addLegend(
    "bottomright", 
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~species, 
    title = "Species", 
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var d = document.querySelectorAll('.info.legend i');
      for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
        d[i].style.borderRadius = '50%';
        d[i].style.width = '12px';
        d[i].style.height = '12px';
        d[i].style.marginTop = '3px';
      }
    }
  ")
```
